title: Delivery Unit Head (SEO)
description:
**Company Description \-** 




  





 Infidigit is a digital growth company specializing in AI\-powered organic growth solutions for startups, MSMEs, and large enterprises. The organization’s core expertise spans SEO, CRO, ASO, local search, and content marketing, driving measurable impact across industries such as e\-commerce, BFSI, education, gaming, wellness, and healthcare. Infidigit partners with clients across India, the Middle East, Australia, South Africa, Canada, and the US, combining global perspective with localized strategies. With over 150 SEO experts, 1M\+ pages optimized, and 250M\+ monthly sessions delivered, the team has earned 55\+ awards from platforms like SMX, APAC, ET SHARK, and BW. Applicants can expect to join a high\-performance, data\-driven environment focused on innovation and long\-term client success.
 



  





**About the role \-** 




  






 The Group Head – AI \+ SEO, Content, Performance, CRO \& other COEs will own and scale the Delivery unit with end\-to\-end accountability for revenue, profitability, delivery excellence, client retention, operational efficiency, and people \& capability development for India and US region.
 





 The role will be responsible for building a high\-performing delivery organisation that consistently delivers measurable client outcomes while improving margins, productivity, scalability, and client lifetime value. The Delivery Unit Group Head will work closely with Sales, Solutions, Content, Backlink Acquisition, and other functions to drive growth and expand the business across existing and new accounts.
 





 Should be flexible with timings.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:\-** 




  





**1\. Business Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 



* **Accrued Revenue Management:** 

 Own the delivery performance to achieve annual accrued revenue targets.
* **Profitability:** 

 Drive gross margins, cost efficiency, and overall profitability of the business unit.
* **Account Retention \& Continuity:** 

 Own the retention, continuity and drive revenue growth of portfolio accounts.
* **Pre\-Sales Solutioning \& Win Rate:** 

 Partner with sales and solutions teams to develop compelling, differentiated proposals and solutions that improve win rates and deal value, and commercial outcomes.
* **Cross\-sell \& Upsell:** 

 Identify and drive cross\-sell and up\-sell opportunities across enterprise accounts by understanding evolving client needs and business priorities.



  





**2\. Delivery, Margins \& Operational Excellence** 



* **Delivery Ownership:** 

 Ensure high\-quality, timely, and outcome\-oriented delivery across the portfolio while maintaining agreed commercial and profitability parameters.
* **Effort \& Cost Control:** 

 Optimise effort deployment, productivity, and delivery costs to protect and improve margins.
* **Capacity \& Revenue Optimization:** 

 Effectively manage resource allocation, utilisation, productivity, employee capacity, and workload across teams and engagements.
* **Outcome Delivery:** 

 Track and achieve defined project performance benchmarks and business outcomes across portfolio accounts.
* **Operational Discipline:** 

 Drive effective adoption of existing systems, workflows, timesheets, billable tracking, utilization metrics and KPIs to improve operational metrics and accountability.
* **Systematic Project Reviews:** 

 Establish and institutionalise a structured project review mechanism across the portfolio, with defined review cadence, standard KPIs, and clear ownership.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 

 Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, productivity, scalability, and quality through standardisation, automation, and process optimisation.



  





**3\. Systems Automation, Quality \& Governance** 



* **System Orientation:** 

 Drive adoption of Odoo system as the single source of truth for project tracking, timesheets, resource allocation, billing, and performance KPIs, eliminating dependency on offline spreadsheets.
 
**Data \& Dashboard Adoption:** 

 Ensure managers and teams use dashboards and operational data to proactively monitor performance and take corrective action.
* **Client Satisfaction:** 

 Maintain a Client Satisfaction (CSAT) rating of 4\.0\+ across the business portfolio. Proactively identify client concerns, risks, and opportunities and drive timely resolution.
* **Client Relationship Management:** 

 Drive timely resolution of escalations while strengthening client relationships,retention, account expansion, and long\-term relationship value.
* **Operations Compliance:** 

 Enforce adherence to delivery SOPs, billing milestones, quality standards, commercial controls and governance frameworks.
* **Risk Management:** 

 Proactively identify delivery, commercial, people, and client risks and implement mitigation plans before they impact business outcomes.



  





**4\. People Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* **Leadership Development:** 

 Lead, mentor, and develop managers and future leaders to build a strong leadership pipeline within the Delivery unit. Build leadership depth and succession capability within the business unit.
* **Performance Management:** 

 Establish clear goals, KRAs/ KPIs, performance expectations, and career paths for the team.
* **Capability Building:** 

 Build capabilities in AI \+ SEO, AEO/GEO/LLM optimisation, content strategy, analytics, client management, commercial acumen, and delivery management.
* **Learning \& Development:** 

 Drive capability development through quarterly training, knowledge\-sharing sessions, coaching, and mentoring, and best\-practice sharing across the organisation.
* **Culture \& Accountability:** 

 Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, customer focus, and performance accountability.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements:** 




  





**Experience:** 



* Approximately 10\-12 years of experience in Digital Marketing, SEO, or related domains.
* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience with accountability for revenue, P\&L, or business\-unit performance.
* Proven experience managing large enterprise accounts and multi\-disciplinary teams.



  





**Domain Expertise:** 

  
 



* Strong understanding of SEO \& Content Strategy
* Strong understanding of AEO/GEO/LLM and AI\-led search is a must.



  





**Commercial Acumen:** 

  
 



* Strong understanding of revenue, margins, profitability, utilisation, and cost management.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and convert new business, cross\-sell, and upsell opportunities.
* Strong pre\-sales, solutioning, proposal development, and commercial negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance client value, delivery feasibility, and business profitability.



  





**System Orientation \& Analytics:** 



* Comfortable working with ERP systems, dashboards, KPIs, utilisation, financial metrics, and operational data.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven approach to business and operational decision\-making.
* Strong orientation towards automation, process improvement, and operational discipline.



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume at preeti.fadikar@infidigit.com

title: SEO Analyst
description:
**Position: SEO Analyst** 




**Experience: 2 years \& above** 




**Location: Goregaon (5 days work from office)** 




  





**Job description \-:** 




 As an SEO Analyst, you will play a crucial role in optimizing websites and online content to improve their visibility in search engine results pages (SERPs) and drive organic traffic. You will employ various SEO techniques, strategies, and tools to enhance website rankings and ensure a strong online presence for the company.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




**1\) Keyword Research:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth keyword research to identify relevant and high\-traffic keywords for the industry.
 



 • Analyze keyword competitiveness and search trends to make informed content decisions.
 



  





**2\) On\-Page Optimization:** 




 • Optimize website content, meta tags, headings, and images for targeted keywords.
 



 • Ensure website structure and navigation are search engine\-friendly.
 



 • Implement schema markup and structured data where applicable.
 



  





**3\) Off\-Page Optimization:** 




 • Develop and execute off\-page SEO strategies, including link\-building campaigns.
 



 • Monitor and evaluate backlink quality, disavow toxic links, and build high\-quality, authoritative backlinks.
 



  





**4\) Content Strategy:** 




 • Collaborate with content creators to develop SEO\-friendly content that aligns with keyword research.
 



 • Optimize existing content for better search engine visibility.
 



  





**5\) Technical SEO:** 




 • Identify and resolve technical SEO issues, such as crawl errors, broken links, and site speed improvements.
 



 • Work with web developers to implement technical SEO recommendations.
 



  





**6\) SEO Analytics:** 




 • Monitor website performance using SEO tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO software.
 



 • Provide regular reports on SEO performance, including traffic, rankings, and conversions.
 



 • Analyzing reports
 



 • KPI Drop/Increase analysis
 



  





**7\) Stay Informed:** 




 • Stay up\-to\-date with search engine algorithm updates and industry trends.
 



 • Continuously research and implement best practices in SEO.
 



  





**8\) Competitive Analysis:** 




 • Analyze competitor websites to identify strengths and weaknesses in their SEO strategies.
 



 • Use insights to refine and improve your SEO approach.
 



  





**9\) Client Communication:** 




 • The candidate will also be involved in client communication.
 



  





**10\) Team Handling:** 




 • The candidate has to have experience of at least handling 2\-3 team members.
 



  





**Qualifications / Experience :** 




 • Knowledge in Search Engine Optimization – SEO.
 



 • Web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Webmaster Tools.
 



 • CMS environments such as WordPress etc.
 



 • MS Office – Excel, Word etc.
 



 • GA4/SEMrush/Ahrefs/screaming frog 
 



 • Basic knowledge of the fundamentals of the search engine industry.
 



 • Knowledge of HTML and website administrations.
 



 • Ability to identify problems.
 



  





**Interested candidates can share resumes at \- prajakta.chaugule@infidigit.com OR send us on WhatsApp at \- 7700947306\.**
